news.title: Bengaluru: Kalyan Nagar residents protest commercial establishment in residential area
news.para: Residents of Kalyan Nagar 2nd Stage voiced strong opposition to the proposed transformation of a residential property into a commercial café. Their primary concerns revolved around potential disturbances, particularly the impact of increased foot traffic on children’s health. Protesters pointed out the likelihood of noise pollution and parking troubles, and some cited instances of rudeness from the café owner when expressing their grievances.

news.title: India to add 51.1 million sq ft of mall space by 2031; NCR to lead supply: Report
news.para: India’s top seven cities are expected to add about 51.1 million sq ft of shopping mall space by 2031, taking total stock to 143.2 million sq ft, according to JLL. Large-format malls will account for 56% of the upcoming supply.

news.title: Housing sales rise 3% to one lakh units in Q3 2026; launches up 18%: Report
news.para: Housing sales across the top seven cities increased 3% year-on-year to about 1,00,220 units in Q3 2026, while new launches rose 18% to 1,14,320 units, according to Anarock. The value of homes sold increased 2% to approximately ₹1.55 lakh crore.

news.title: India office leasing rises 7% to 54.4 million sq ft in Jan-Sep 2026: Report
news.para: Gross office leasing across India’s top seven markets rose 7% year-on-year to 54.4 million sq ft during January-September 2026, according to Colliers. Q3 leasing stood at 18.7 million sq ft, up 7% sequentially and 9% annually.

news.title: Akshaye Khanna buys apartment in Mumbai’s Malabar Hill for ₹33.26 crore
news.para: Actor Akshaye Vinod Khanna has purchased an apartment at 30 Little Gibbs in Malabar Hill, Mumbai, for ₹33.26 crore, according to property registration documents reviewed by Square Yards. The apartment has a carpet area of 2,341 sq ft and comes with three parking spaces.

news.title: Bhubaneswar expands, but comprehensive development plan 2040 notification stays in limbo
news.para: Bhubaneswar Development Authority is in the process of finalizing a GIS-based Comprehensive Development Plan that will integrate both current and future urban layouts. Unfortunately, the anticipated notification for the vision 2040 plan is still awaited, leading to ambiguity regarding development timelines. Although surveys and community inputs are in place, the lack of legal backing poses a significant barrier.

news.title: Reduced rent for Dharavi locals refusing to vacate: Adani Navbharat Developers
news.para: Residents in Dharavi face eviction notices from Adani Navbharat Developers, sparking worry and anxiety across communities like Ganpat Nagar and Azad Nagar. The company warns that procrastination in moving out could jeopardize their rental benefits. With rental costs in neighboring areas skyrocketing, residents struggle to find affordable housing alternatives, fearing the specter of homelessness during this time of building transformation.

news.title: Seal business units in housing zones first, SC tells agencies, bars selective action
news.para: The Supreme Court has ordered immediate sealing of properties being used for commercial activities within residential areas. The recent enforcement by the DTCP has resulted in several unauthorized buildings being sealed. Additionally, the court highlighted the necessity of adhering to land-use regulations, urging authorities to enforce these rules impartially to maintain the integrity of designated land uses in city planning.

news.title: Road width to decide commercial use of property, says draft Bhopal development plan 2047
news.para: The Bhopal Development Plan 2047 introduces guidelines for commercial endeavors based on road widths. It stipulates that no major commercial ventures will take place on roads less than 12 metres wide, permitting only limited professional activities to ease traffic congestion. Roads that are broader will support a mix of low-impact and heavy-traffic businesses. Additionally, property owners must remit designated fees to secure commercial licenses as per the new framework.

news.title: NBCC to resume work on 16 stalled Supertech projects in January 2027
news.para: After facing numerous delays, work on 16 Supertech projects is anticipated to recommence on January 16, 2027, bringing hope to about 14,000 homebuyers awaiting their homes. NBCC plans to issue construction tenders across multiple sites in the NCR region. Though financing issues remain a challenge, the stock of unsold flats could help ease the situation.

news.title: Goa RERA seeks court's intervention to complete stalled housing project
news.para: The Goa Real Estate Regulatory Authority has taken steps to enforce a previous order against Hrija Construction. Their 2020 ruling required the timely completion of a housing project and the possession of flats by buyers. With the developer's inability to meet these requirements, Rera initiated criminal proceedings for non-registration, and the district court has now closed execution proceedings due to the project's incompletion.

news.title: Homestays in Hampi must secure legal tag by September 30
news.para: Homestays in Anjanadri and the Anegondi region are allowed to apply for registration under new guidelines. Owners must secure approval from the gram panchayat and Hampi World Heritage Area Management Authority. They have until September 30 to complete the registration process and avoid legal action. So far, the Koppal district administration has received 36 applications for registration as unauthorised homestays operate without licenses.

news.title: Rajkot civic body to survey properties across all 18 wards
news.para: Rajkot Municipal Corporation will start a city-wide property survey on September 28 for database updates. This survey will cover all residential and non-residential properties across 18 wards in Rajkot. A private agency will conduct the survey using a mobile application to geo-tag and record property details. Residents are advised not to share personal information or financial details with surveyors.

news.title: Houses to roads, DTCP razes illegal colony on 14 acres in Gurugram
news.para: In a decisive enforcement action, Gurugram authorities took down illegal colonies and an unauthorized market. The crackdown targeted Sultanpur village and Alimuddinpur, where officials dismantled boundary walls and roads to curb further illicit activities. The District Town Planner assured the public of continuous monitoring and efforts against such violations in the area, emphasizing the need to address unauthorized plotting and construction effectively.

news.title: Will shape Bhopal’s planned urban development: Madhya Pradesh CM on draft master plan
news.para: Mohan Yadav has unveiled the draft Bhopal Development Plan-2047, focusing on strategic urban planning while prioritizing natural preservation. Key elements include Green Transferable Development Rights aimed at aiding landowners in specific eco-friendly zones. The Bhopal Municipal Corporation's recent steps align with this comprehensive regulatory vision. Legal evaluations of properties will persist under the existing framework until full approval of the new plan is secured.

news.title: Delhi civic body approves up to 75% rebate on regularisation charges in PM-UDAY colonies
news.para: The Municipal Corporation of Delhi has announced an impressive 75% rebate on regularization fees for unauthorized colonies. This initiative, part of the PM-UDAY scheme, is set to ease financial burdens for eligible residents. To qualify for the discount, applicants must complete the regularization by October 31, 2026. The initiative not only reduces costs but also strengthens property rights while launching awareness initiatives and self-assessment tools to simplify registration.

news.title: SC orders sealing of over 16,000 properties, demolition of illegal structures in Meerut
news.para: The Supreme Court has mandated the sealing and demolition of over 16,000 unauthorized buildings in Meerut. This ruling comes in response to troubling reports surrounding illegal housing developments in the region. A judicial commission has been established to delve into the circumstances and assess the lack of action from local authorities.

news.title: Delhi development body holds investors' meet to push its slum rehabilitation plan
news.para: On September 25, the Delhi Development Authority hosted an Investors' Meet aimed at propelling its In-Situ Slum Rehabilitation Programme. Engaging developers explored prospects and shared insights into enhancing rehabilitation projects in Delhi. The Master Plan for Delhi 2047 envisions assisting around 17 lakh JJ cluster inhabitants, significantly boosting housing conditions.

news.title: Innovist leases 2.62 lakh sq ft warehouse in Gurugram for five years
news.para: Onesto Labs, which operates Innovist brands including Bare Anatomy, Chemist at Play and SunScoop, has leased about 2.62 lakh sq ft at Horizon Industrial Park in Gurugram. The five-year transaction entails monthly rent of about ₹72.14 lakh once both phases become rent-bearing and an estimated rental outgo of around ₹47 crore over the tenure.
